subject: IAM evidence request & SOC 2 status - FitWell Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@fitwell.health>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: IAM evidence & next steps from today's demo

Alex - thanks for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Summary from call:
- Primary concerns: SSO integration (SAML), provisioning (SCIM), and RBAC/admin controls for multi-tenant workflows.
- Security team will require SOC 2 attestation (Type II preferred), GDPR/HIPAA controls mapping, and completion of our vendor security questionnaire (SVQ).

Action items I can help with: 
1) Provide IAM evidence artifacts: SSO/SAML configuration guide, SCIM attribute mapping, RBAC admin role docs - see list below.
2) Share SOC 2 summary and expected timing for a full report.
3) Kick off SVQ - please confirm primary reviewer and timeline.

Requested artifacts (we can share immediately):
- SSO/SAML: public metadata + SP-initiated steps, sample IdP metadata file, failure/retry behavior doc.
- SCIM: supported attributes, provisioning flow, bulk provisioning options, deprovisioning timeline.
- RBAC/Admin: default roles, granular permissions for route/model access, audit log retention for admin actions.
- SOC 2: summary of scope, last Type II date, auditor.

If you can confirm who from your security/procurement team will own the SVQ (and a target date), I'll attach the initial artifacts and a short SOC 2 summary. Otherwise I can send the SVQ to procurement@fitwell.health.

Next steps: 
- You: confirm SVQ reviewer + ideal deadline (EOD Wed 6/23?)
- Me: share SOC 2 summary + IAM evidence bundle, and schedule a 30m technical handoff with our infra engineer (Aditya) for SAML/SCIM specifics.

Attachments: none on this message - will send a package in follow-up.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@fitwell.health>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: IAM evidence & next steps from today's demo

Alex - thanks, attaching the initial package. Summary below and what we'll deliver by EOD today: 

Deliverables attached: soc2-summary-2027.pdf (summary of scope + last Type II date), iam-evidence.zip (contains SAML guide, SCIM attribute map, RBAC matrix), saml-metadata.xml (SP metadata).

Quick answers to your questions: 
- SAML: Redwood supports both SP- and IdP-initiated flows. We recommend SP-initiated for a smoother recovery path. NameID: we accept persistent and email Address formats; we can map to userName during provisioning. Certificate rotation: currently annual by default; we support rolling certs with a 30-day dual-validity window.
- SCIM: We support userName, givenName, familyName, emails, groups by default and can add custom attributes (employeeType, location) via attribute mapping. Provisioning latency: near real-time for individual updates; bulk syncs run nightly by default.
- RBAC/admin controls: included in iam-evidence.zip - default roles (admin/ops/viewer), audit log retention (365 days for admin actions), approval flows for role elevation.

Next steps from us: 
1) I'll send the SVQ back with answers populated where possible and flag any items for engineering (target: 6/23 EOD).
2) Aditya (cc) will schedule a 30m technical call for SAML/SCIM config and to walk through the metadata. Please share preferred times.

Links: 
- Shared QA folder: https://redwood.app/secure/drive/fitwell-qa
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/98765

Attachments: soc2-summary-2027.pdf, iam-evidence.zip, saml-metadata.xml

Best,
Marissa Cole

marissa@redwood.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@fitwell.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 10:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: IAM evidence & next steps from today's demo

Alex - looping in some quick technical detail and attaching saml-metadata.xml (same copy in the ZIP). A few implementation notes for your IdP team: 

- SP details: ACS (Assertion Consumer Service) URL: https://api.redwood.ai/saml/acs, EntityID: urn:redwood:inference:sp:prod, RelayState supported.
- NameID mapping: if you send emailAddress we'll map to user.email; persistent will map to user.id. Send attributes: givenName, familyName, email, groups.
- Certificate rotation: provide new cert at least 10 days before expiry; we support dual certs for overlap.
- SCIM attribute mapping: by default we map groups -> role assignments; for employeeType/location we need the attribute name (e.g., urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:custom:2.0:User:employeeType) - if you can provide the HRIS attribute keys I'll add mapping rules.

I'll be available for a 30m call Thu 6/24 between 9a-12p PT or Fri 6/25 1p-4p PT. Please let us know which works and I'll send a calendar invite + a short runbook for the test plan (create user -> verify provisioning -> test SP login).

Attachment: saml-metadata.xml

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
